posts.hook: Most ECC customers have not started deep migration work, and the 2027 deadline is compressing timelines.
posts.key_stat: More than 60% of SAP ECC customers have not begun deep migration work; only 40% of treasury teams run fully integrated ERP and TMS ecosystems.
posts.visual_direction: A clean stat card leading with 60% as the dominant figure, with the 40% treasury-integration stat as supporting context, framing bank connectivity as the underestimated migration risk.
